description: NaTaCl₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaTaCl₆ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.92 Å. Ta is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Ta-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.47 Å. There are six inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ta atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Ta atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ta atom. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Ta atom. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ta atom. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Ta atom.
